name: bracket-matcher
author: lumine-code
description: Highlights and jumps between matching brackets, and autocompletes brackets and quotes.
backgroundTips: You can jump to the bracket matching the one at the cursor with {{ 'bracket-matcher:go-to-matching-bracket' | keystroke }}
You can select everything inside the brackets around the cursor with {{ 'bracket-matcher:select-inside-brackets' | keystroke }}

autocompleteCharacters.title: Autocomplete Characters
autocompleteCharacters.description: Autocompleted characters treated as matching pairs, such as `()`, and `{}`.

pairsWithExtraNewline.title: Pairs With Extra Newline
pairsWithExtraNewline.description: Automatically add a newline between the pair when enter is pressed.

autocompleteBrackets.title: Autocomplete Brackets
autocompleteBrackets.description: Autocomplete bracket and quote characters, such as `(` and `)`, and `"`.

wrapSelectionsInBrackets.title: Wrap Selections In Brackets
wrapSelectionsInBrackets.description: Wrap selected text in brackets or quotes when the editor contains selections and the opening bracket or quote is typed.

highlightMatchingLineNumber.title: Highlight Matching Line Number
highlightMatchingLineNumber.description: Highlight the line number of the matching bracket.

alwaysSkipClosingPairs.title: Always Skip Closing Pairs
alwaysSkipClosingPairs.description: Always skip closing pairs in front of the cursor.

marker.title: Marker
marker.description: Settings of the brackets layer drawn on the scrollbar and minimap by the marker hub.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show matching bracket positions on the scrollbar and minimap.
